_readme: Edit these values, then run: python3 build.py  (and commit the regenerated files). Leave a value empty to keep that feature switched off. gbp_maps_url / gbp_review_url: paste the real links from your Google Business Profile once it is verified (see docs/GOOGLE_BUSINESS_PROFILE.md). photographer_instagram_url: the photographer's own Instagram profile link (https://www.instagram.com/<username>/), shown in the couple-shoot page portfolio section only when filled in.
